ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/grey) mottled pixels distributed primarily at the distal lobe extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white mottled clusters are visible at the lateral tips of both lobes. The right lobe exhibits distinct, vertically-oriented white bands near the trailing edge, while the left lobe displays a more diffuse, concentrated mottled patch at the anterior-lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation with an approximate vertex angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge. The left lobe displays 4-6 prominent, high-amplitude jagged peaks. The right lobe displays more rounded, lower-frequency serrations transitioning to a smoother profile toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature on both outer margins, sweeping symmetrically upward to acute terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacle attachment points) are concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible; specifically, three prominent near-vertical lines on the inner-right lobe and several fainter diagonal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct vertical rake marks on the central-right lobe surface and barnacle colonization at the lateral fluke tips.
